description: Replace a page's body with `body`, in FULL - this is not an append. `base_revision` is REQUIRED and must be the one get_page just gave you: if the page has moved on since, the write is refused and names the newer revision, so read it again and re-apply your change. That refusal is the point - two agents race on a page exactly as readily as two people. Writing does not publish: a live page keeps showing readers the published version until you publish the new one. `note` is a short line about what changed, shown on the page's history.

baseRevision.description:
base_revision is the revision you read before writing (from get_page).
 REQUIRED: if it is no longer current the write is refused, naming the newer
 one, so a second writer cannot silently overwrite the first.

body.description:
body is the new markdown, in full - this replaces the page, it does not
 append to it.

note.description: note is a short line about what changed - it shows on the page's history.

page.description: page is the page's id or its full path within the wiki.

space.description:
space optionally selects which of your spaces to act in (an id or name
 from list_spaces). Omit it when you belong to a single space.

wiki.description: wiki is the wiki the page is in - its id or slug.

name: update_page
title: Update page
